label: Research pool 23 Oct: single-company SEIS/EIS listings

payload.writeUp: Claude Code research, 23 Oct 2026: single-company SEIS/EIS listings open to individuals. Of the platforms reachable, only Angel Investment Network UK had a usable single-company feed, so every company here is an AIN pitch checked against the company's own website. AIN is a contact route (register, then message the founders); investment happens off-platform, so access is 'contactable'. SEIS/EIS is the company's own claim; no HMRC advance-assurance letter was seen. Five listings were posted by brokers, noted per company.

candidate.name: Aquaint
candidate.teaser: Mobile-first compliance, checklists and team comms app for hospitality sites; £400k SEIS/EIS round over half filled.
candidate.description: Aquaint sells a hospitality compliance app that replaces paper checklists with food-safety checks, temperature logs, audits and team communications. Its about page names Jayden Patel (CEO, ex-PwC and HPE) and Sunil Patel (CTO, founder of pharmacy compliance platform Pharmsmart), with offices in Manchester and London. The Angel Investment Network pitch is raising £400,000 (min £25,000) with £225,000 shown as raised, and claims 0% customer churn, 113% net revenue retention, 2,000+ users across 70+ paying sites and a £168k Innovate UK programme. Valuation is not disclosed and the listing was posted through a broker account. Main risks: crowded hospitality-ops software market and unverified SaaS metrics.

candidate.researchRuleMatched: UK SEIS and EIS round under £1m target with an open individual-angel route
